content: We need count of carbonyl groups in the molecule. IR spectrum shows peaks at 1704 and 1681 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch ~1700 cm-1. Could be one carbonyl (C=O) maybe two? Two peaks could be due to conjugation or different carbonyls. Need more info. Could use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Let's get carbon NMR.
